name: fertilizacerrado
description: Atalhos para operar a stack Docker do FertilizaCerrado

scripts.restart: docker compose down && docker compose up -d
scripts.rebuild: docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api pnpm prisma db seed
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api pnpm prisma migrate deploy
scripts.test: docker compose exec api pnpm test && docker compose exec frontend pnpm test
scripts.test:api: docker compose exec api pnpm test
scripts.test:frontend: docker compose exec frontend pnpm test
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose exec frontend pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.verify-link: docker compose logs api | grep -oE 'http://[^ ]*(verificar-email|redefinir-senha)[^ ]*' | tail -1
